factors.name: Type
factors.relationship: Canonical blocks nested within original Type; Type/Scale source categories do not establish physical or experiment identity.

limitations: One exploratory development population; unknown physical/assay dependencies prevent independent-generalization claims.
The existing pooled scores hide context variation; Type A has negative R2 and target-range extrapolation for both models.
Full-source X descriptors elsewhere in the source report have a different scope from train-fitted diagnostics; they did not select these models.
No matched random-CV contrast, stress/control design or test of frozen H1-H5 is supplied.
facts.prediction_population: Held-out Type contexts within UCPH tablet development data, active substance percent mass/mass, X content 1.0.0. Future contexts remain unvalidated.

spectral_support.description: Existing train-fitted PC1/PC2 projection summaries for held-out Type A; no PCA is recomputed.
limitations: Two projections do not establish full spectral support; other contexts have their own summaries.
spectral_support.reference_population: Type A fold training population, excluding Type A
spectral_support.representation: Raw spectra; PCA centered/fitted on the corresponding training fold

spectral_support.description: Qualified continuous support is explicitly unavailable in the source report.
limitations: Do not substitute a truncated-PCA moment estimate or interpret support as a risk probability.

split.description: Four outer leave-one-original-Type-out folds, three inner remaining-Type folds; all 31 declared canonical blocks preserved. Not leave-one-experiment-out.

conditions: If the objective is prediction outside the experimental context, match the tested novelty to that objective.
stronger_claims_not_established: Universal external-population transfer, causal shortcut attribution and deployment-risk probabilities.
Independence of unrecorded physical specimens or shared assay references.
Unseen-population transfer from random/representative CV or X-derived clusters alone.
New-experiment generalization from genotype, block or instrument holdout alone; those novelty types are distinct.
Generalization to future unseen levels beyond the tested exclusions without representative independent evidence.
supported_claims: Existing prediction-error evidence describes the logo evaluation, conditional on the declared protocol.
Declared exclusion of Type (other, verified evidence) describes prediction for the observed held-out levels only; it does not certify independence.

limitations: One exploratory development population; unknown physical/assay dependencies prevent independent-generalization claims.
